purpose: Immutable original PCW Z80 image identities and measured leading CP/M BDOS-call byte sequence. The byte sequence is not admitted as proof of a transient-program load address, entry, or operational CP/M environment.
remaining_requirements: original PCW CP/M loader or disk context
transient-program load address and effective entry
PCW memory, bank, and firmware state
qualified analyzer configuration and cross-tool disagreement record
non_claim: A CP/M BDOS call byte sequence in a retained PCW image does not establish how the program was loaded, whether the sequence executes, CP/M version or environment, source recovery, or runtime behavior.
